name: A Momentary Goodwill
source:
People bring each other gifts when it snows.

A Momentary Goodwill is a short, creepy visual novel.

Play as a knight far from home, braving the mountains and cold on a quest to rescue a kidnapped friend. When your journey reaches an unexpected snag, you receive an offer of help from the strangest of places. But whose help will you accept? What reward will you receive at the end of your journey?

[From [url=https://octofan.itch.io/a-momentary-goodwill]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
下雪时人们互相赠送礼物。

《瞬间的善意》是一部简短而令人毛骨悚然的视觉小说。

扮演一名远离家乡的骑士，冒着高山和严寒，去营救被绑架的朋友。当你的旅程遇到意想不到的障碍时，你会从最奇怪的地方得到帮助。但你会接受谁的帮助呢？旅程结束时你会得到什么奖励？

[来自[url=https://octofan.itch.io/a-momentary-goodwill]Itch.io[/url]]
